content.p1: Easily convert your high-quality TIFF (Tagged Image File Format) images to the universally compatible JPG format. Perfect for sharing prints or scans online.
content.p2: TIFF files are often huge and not supported by web browsers. converting them to JPG makes them smaller and easy to view, share, and upload anywhere.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: TIFFs are great for printing but too large for the web. JPG is much smaller and works everywhere.
faq.a2: No, JPG is a flat format. Your multi-layer TIFF will be flattened into a single image.
